name: Create a fast unit test file

messages.content:
Create a fast unit test file at tests/app.test.js using Node's built-in test runner (node:test).

Test these specific ReelVault functions and edge cases:
1. detectVideoFormat: Test uppercase extensions (.MP4, .WEBM), URLs with query strings (?token=123), hash anchors (#t=10), and null/invalid URLs.
2. normalizeAndAutoRewriteVideoUrl: Verify .gifv URLs are automatically rewritten to .mp4, and escaped HTML (&) is unescaped.
3. VIDEO_FORMAT_CATALOG: Verify all 19 extensions exist and have valid mime types.

Rules:
1. Do not make any real network requests or load FFmpeg.
2. Lock the test file with "chmod 444 tests/app.test.js" immediately after creating it.
3. Run the test with "node --test tests/app.test.js".
4. If any test fails, fix it ONLY in app.js. You are strictly forbidden from altering tests/app.test.js.
5. Finish and show the test output.
